decisions.limits: This is release-note review, not a security audit. Non-Latin CMaps, OCR, image decoding, font subsetting, signing, network fetch, table detection and wrapper APIs are excluded.

discovery_provenance: Maintained ecosystem catalog queried for document/PDF extraction, then exact official release, source and license checks. Stars are not acceptance.
smallest_sufficient_choice: One native extractor, deterministic geometry processing, scoped exact phrase retrieval; no embeddings, model downloads, MCP registration or automatic memory.
